text: Which of the following is NOT a part of the 4 Ps of Marketing?
explanation: The 4 Ps of Marketing are Product, Price, Promotion, and People (not Place). People refers to the personnel involved in the marketing process.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is a characteristic of Advertising?
explanation: Advertising is a form of mass communication that reaches a large number of people through various media channels.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is a key difference between Advertising and Personal Selling?
options: Advertising is one-to-one communication, while Personal Selling is mass communication.
Advertising is mass communication, while Personal Selling is one-to-one communication.
Advertising is a push strategy, while Personal Selling is a pull strategy.
Advertising is a pull strategy, while Personal Selling is a push strategy.
correctAnswer: Advertising is mass communication, while Personal Selling is one-to-one communication.
explanation: Advertising is a form of mass communication that reaches a large number of people, while Personal Selling is a one-to-one communication between a salesperson and a customer.
subject: Business Studies
